item.description: Donald Trump spent his Saturday posting fake pictures of himself again. The fakes are his claims that he is holy, that he is young, that the world is his to take. Also today, California became the first place in America where AI content must include data showing where it came from. One state now requires fabrications to identify themselves. item.title: Cats are beloved in Türkiye (and Iran)
item.description: In Türkiye, two friends moving into a new house spotted a cat trapped on a nearby rooftop and came up with a rescue plan. They extended an ironing board from their window to the roof, creating a makeshift bridge that allowed the cat to safely walk into their apartment without injury. - TRT World The melodious sound in the background is the azan, the Islamic call to prayer. This particular one is by the late Azeri-Iranian muezzin, Rahim Moazenzadeh.
